description:
Set up the email newsletter infrastructure in Magento. 

1. Configure Newsletter Settings (Stores > Configuration > Customers > Newsletter): Set 'Allow Guest Subscription' to Yes and 'Need to Confirm' to No.

2. Create a Newsletter Template (Marketing > Communications > Newsletter Templates): Name it 'Holiday Collection 2024', Subject 'Discover Our Holiday Collection - Exclusive Early Access', Sender Name 'NestWell Home', Sender Email 'newsletter@nestwell-home.com'. The content must be HTML with an <h1> heading 'Holiday Collection', a paragraph, and a list (<ul> or <ol>) of at least 3 items.

3. Subscribe 5 specific customers to the newsletter (Customers > All Customers): Alice Johnson, Bob Smith, Carol Williams, David Brown, and Emma Davis.

metadata.template_subject: Discover Our Holiday Collection - Exclusive Early Access
